mode: Image generation with user-requested existing icon reference (I2I asset reference)

inputImages.role: Actual category icons already used in TripLOG; rendered directly from runtime SVGs. See icon-sources.json.

userAuthorization: 현재 프로젝트에 있는 아이콘 기준 목업 및 이미지 생성 목업을 명시적으로 요청.

selected.feedback: Replace missing-duration log sentences with icons or concise visualization.

implementation: Image mockups only. No HTML UI mockup, production source, travel data or deployment changes. Raster reference-sheet helper is temporary asset processing only.

concepts.prompt:
Create an image-generated mobile mockup of TripLOG’s collapsed itinerary summary at 390 × 844 CSS pixels. Use the existing project category icons from the supplied reference as the only destination graphics. Preserve their shapes, colors and proportions; reuse the same category icon for different places. Do not invent location-specific stickers, landmark illustrations or scenery.

Keep TripLOG’s white background, navy text and fine outlines, small offset shadows, yellow #fff05a accents, pastel blue #bce6fb and pink #f7afc7. Use readable Korean typography around 14–16px. Compact header: TripLOG, “일정 계획”, “도쿄 여행”, “10.20–10.24”, “일정 편집 / 일정 요약”, with summary selected, and a copy icon. Bottom navigation: 개요 / 일정 / 지출 / 리포트 / 설정. Current date is 2026-10-28; retain the historical trip dates October 20–24, 2026.

Remove log-like sentences, missing-input messages, explanatory copy and long arrow-separated place strings. Use category icons, time ranges, stop counts, short place names and expansion chevrons. No expanded itinerary, device hardware or OS chrome.

Use a calendar-badge layout: three compact white day cards, each with a narrow date badge, bold time and stop count, and three small destination icons with short labels. Keep icon size around 28–36 CSS pixels, directly on the white surface without nested icon frames. Show all three cards comfortably.
